notes.title: The Worms Invade Golf With Your Friends – Update Live Now!
notes.notes:
We are super excited to share this crossover with Worms landing in Golf With Your Friends - a multiplayer mini golf game for up to 12 players. 

Check out the trailer now:


[previewyoutube=Cr6VmLJuHqQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]The full update includes: [/h1]
[list]
[*] A new Worms themed 18 hole course
[*] New mechanics including jet-pack and snap freeze
[*] New Worms themed obstacles and hazards
[/list]

Plus more!

Find and pick-up the jet pack to fly across open chasms in the war zone but be sure not to run out of fuel as it is a long way down!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2RUn4ih.gif[/img]

Putt around or use to your advantage a whole host of new Worms themed obstacles. These include: Mines, explosive barrels, Holy Hand Grenade, Sheep, Super Sheep and even the Concrete Donkey!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nxh2JVH.gif[/img]

Want to see more? Head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/431240/Golf_With_Your_Friends/]Steam store[/url] page!

notes.title: Introducing the Brimstone update!
notes.notes:

Hi everyone

As we’ve officially hit the warm summer months, we thought we’d turn up the temperatures in-game as well. Introducing our new [b]Brimstone[/b] update, which lets you play Worms W.M.D in a pretty fiery place you may know as hell. Oh, and [b]Brimstone is a FREE update[/b], of course!

The Brimstone update includes:[list]
[*] The Brimstone map theme
[*] 10 new Brimstone-themed hats
[*] 5 Brimstone-themed gravestones
[*] [b]ALL crafted weapons are now available in schemes![/b]
[*] Various bug fixes and optimisations.[/list]
With ALL crafted weapons now available to be used in a scheme, a new dynamic weapons panel automatically adjusts in size to accommodate. Customise your loadout in Scheme Options > Crafted Weapons or select the Full Wormage scheme to jump straight in!

[b]An example of the massively expanded weapons menu:[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/c5c45b206fada26e4e1f8acc6b495af94be9af27.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/311a5b8a8fee94676c7b7a84106e406ee7ae354d.png[/img][/url]
[i](Click to enlarge)[/i]

To check out the Brimstone update, simply update your game!

See you on the battlefield.

notes.title: Wormhole Update - Live Now!
notes.notes:
Hey community, 

Today we’re happy to announce that the Wormhole update is live on Worms W.M.D!

This content update introduces brand new locations for you to wage wormy warfare on as well as some quality of life fixes and tweaks.

[h1][b]New Theme - Wormhole[/b][/h1]

Not that long ago, in a galaxy not too far away, the worms crash landed on a strange new world. 

Naturally, they immediately started a turf war to fight over this newly discovered world of tentacle monsters and abandoned alien tech. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/0529c7fe5aa1a00be8bcf03034082990c67d8e4d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Forts – Mushroom and Tree Hugger[/b][/h1]

The worms have been increasing their property portfolio once again, adding two nature themed forts to their list of lairs!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/14df791348bc6a36daf49349b3974c2ffa70ea05.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/1942408d58b5501c4ddebf6cb31735e17dee9c98.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Customisation Items – Three New Hats and Gravestones[/b][/h1] 

The cherry on the content cake, we’ve added six new customisation items, available immediately to all players!

Looking at that shark gravestone, you’re going to need a bigger drillboat…

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/2416cad4df07475d5d0fd338687170d13eb70b26.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/5436e7356ef544c064ec7e1440d6995778eb5a59.jpg[/img]

As always, we'd love to hear your thoughts on the Wormhole update! 

Please feel free to share your feedback with us at the following locations:

[*][url=https://twitter.com/WormsTeam17]Worms Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Ranked Mode 2.0 - Launch Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/3a12b3f0eb1c84887f6f1e6feb3b91dc68c69824.gif[/img]
Hey Community,

Just popping by to give you an update on Ranked 2.0 for Worms W.M.D!

Originally we had planned to release Ranked 2.0 tomorrow, including the Ranked reset as we moved all players over to the new system.

Unfortunately a rather nasty bug has popped up at the last minute and we've had to push back launch to (hopefully) [b]April 5th[/b].

To celebrate the launch of Ranked 2.0 we've got a few plans...


[h1]Ranked 2.0 Launch Day Plans[/h1]

[b]Take on the Devs[/b]

Yes, the time has finally come for you to take on the actual development team from Worms W.M.D and previous titles. We're talking desiginers, programmers, producers and more...oh and your resident Community Manager will be throwing his hat into the ring too.

We'll be providing a full list of Steam Names to keep an eye out for, but we'll be running the Players vs Devs Ranked Night as so:
[list]
[*]April 5th, 6pm BST - 8pm BST
[*]Official Ranked Queue
[*]Beat us and enter the Hall of Fame, lose and be recorded in the Hall of Shame
[*]Prizes for the top players of the evening
[*]An extra surprise or two...
[/list]
We'll be sharing the full change log including tweaks, improvements and rewards on April 5th, along with the modes launch.

Make a note in your diaries, we're kicking off Ranked 2.0 in style!

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Patch Notes: 14/02/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/2a520c531da6f1042744582aedc4a86cf7cdd7cc.png[/img]
Hey Community,

Love is in the air and the Worms want to make war, not love! 

To aid them in their quest we've kitted them out with a Valentines Day cosmetic pack that includes three themed and three themed gravestones!

This is totally free and you'll find them on your customisation screen once you've downloaded the patch.

Not only do we have some tasty cosmetics for you but a juicy patch including fixes, tweaks and some requested features. See below for the what's included:


[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]NEW CUSTOMISATION ITEMS: x3 Valentine's Day Themed Hats; x3 Valentine’s Day Themed Gravestones
[*]Multiple controllers can now be used!
[*]We continually listen and welcome your thoughts on WMD and from this, we've heard your thoughts on the Drone and have made the following changes:
                - Reduced flight time from 20 to 15 secs
                - Minor reduction in flight speed from 9 to 8.5
                - A slight increase to wind affected 0.8 to 0.9
                - Reduced intermediate scheme from 2 drones to 1
[*]Health bars will now pulse during players turn
[*]Added an message to inform the player when too many teams have been created
[*]Added the ability to be able to set schemes as default options
[*]Added warning beeps to the timer during the Teleport In phase
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue which would allow players infinite ammo on exiting a vehicle
[*]Fixed a crash which some users were experiencing after every online multiplayer match
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented sub goals from unlocking in 'The Escapists' mission
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the 'Steeple Jack' mission from being completed
[*]Fixed an issue where targeting reticule could appear over the pause menu
[*]Fixed an issue which displayed multiple arrows once Worm Lick or Stinger were fired off the edge of the screen
[*]Fixed an issue where black lines could be seen throughout the frontend menus
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the W1 Rocket to continue after a replay
[*]Fixed an issue which caused animal weapons to become stuck on the Mech
[*]Fixed an issue with the aiming of the Homing Missile that required the space bar to be pressed first
[*]Fixed an issue whereby the wind indicator would fade to black during replays
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the worm from being pushed when using the Blowtorch on the Stinger
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the Drone controller to change asset
[*]Multiple issues fixed when standing on top of an Unwanted Present
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the correct animation from playing when the worms fell
[*]Fixed an issue which was causing an asset to flicker during Pro Grenade Training
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing buildings to spawn in the incorrect positions
[*]Fixed to the Homing Missile text during the training mission
[*]Fixed an issue where the worm would be launched out of the Mech on exiting it...look mummy, I can fly!!!
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the Worm Lick payloads to move incorrectly
[*]Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would jump to the centre of the screen when left idle
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the spikes on the Stinger from appearing during a replay
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented special characters from being entered into text fields
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the turn from passing over when roping after detonating a mine
[*]Fixed multiple issues with games appearing in the Browse Game list
[*]Fixed an issue whereby the hotseat still appeared after turning it off in the Scheme Options
[*]Fixed an issue which was causing two prompts to overlap each other
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a delay in the videos playing during the bootflow
[*]Fixed an issue that stopped one of the Liberation buildings from appearing in multiplayer matches
[*]Fixed an issue which highlighted all weapons after using the Girder whilst on the Jetpack
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented animated elements from appearing during replays
[*]Fixed an issue which was awarded both players points after a Ranked Match if one player disconnected
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing the K/D ration to be miscalculated
[*]Fixed an issue in 21:9 which prevented focus on the player names in Global Chat
[*]Fixed an issue which wouldn't display borders for cavern maps on the Liberation theme
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented cavern borders from displaying on custom maps
[*]Fixed an issue whereby the worms low health anim wouldn't update after collecting a health crate
[*]Fixed an issue which was causing the surrender samples from playing repeatedly
[*]Fixed a performance issue on Windows 8 if the game is relaunched
[*]Fixed an issue whereby the hardware cursor would appear after minimising the game using the Windows key, and returning back to W.M.D
[*]Fixed an issue which allowed replays to be skipped with any button on the controller
[*]Fixed an issue which was preventing Drones from being damaged by fire
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing speechbanks to repeat after a worm is hit by a vehicle
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing magnet audio to be heard in the frontend after a match
[*]Fixed an issue where the interiors of buildings could be seen under water during sudden death
[*]Fixed an issue that was preventing certain speechbank samples from being triggered
[*]Fixed an issue which caused aiming to be altered when jumping
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the camera from locating to the worms positions during Teleport In
[/list]

There you have it!

We hope you enjoy the new content. Be sure to let us know what you think of the patch in the comments section below.

notes.title: Worms WMD adds free Liberation update
notes.notes:
The Worms game Tom billed as "a love letter to Armageddon", Worms WMD is a cordial throwback to the team-based strategy 'em up's roots. Its latest incoming update—Liberation—is free and adds a wealth of new tools, weapons and vehicles to help destroy its handful of new levels. 

Free to download as of December 7, WMD's Liberation update adds five new single-player level; four new weapons, including the Mischievous Drone, the W1 Rocket, the Worm Stinger, and the Tasty Worm Lick; and 12 new customisation options, like the Bicorne, Beret, Chinese Hat, and Rubber Glove. 

On top of that, the update adds a new theme "to battle upon including new buildings and tunnels to explore"; while a new drillboat vehicle marks the first seafaring mode of transport to be added to the series. 

In typically off-the-wall Worms fashion, here's some of that in motion:

Free-of-charge, Worms WMD's Liberation update will be made available on December 7. Grab the base game for £19.99/$29.99 via the Humble Store.

notes.notes:

Thanks for the feedback we’ve been getting from you, the Worms community, about how you want Worms W.M.D to continue to evolve. Today’s update brings improvements to performance, bug fixes and a host of balances and tweaks based on the feedback that we’ve been seeing in these forums. 

Here’s the full list of changes:

[h1]Balances and Tweaks[/h1][b]
- Vehicles will now randomly spawn in (5% chance) during Ranked matches instead of at the beginning of the match
- Slightly lowered health of the helicopter (-5 Health)
- Sound of the worm plop increased
- Secondary weapon fuses can now be altered
- The camera will now follow the Sentry Gun Lite when it’s thrown
- Any items under water during sudden death will no longer be visible
- User Generated Content can now be refreshed with a controller
- Girder can now be rotated by holding down a binded key
- Warning beep will now be heard when timer gets too low during Teleport In
- Name and health bars will no longer appear during retreat on rope
- Blow Torch will now destroy barrels when burnt from the top
- Jetpack now has unlimited retreat fuel after placing a girder
- Tweak made to the crafting ingredients for Sheep (-1 Tears of a Worm)
- Tweak made to the crafting ingredients for Jetpack (+1 Banana Bomb Seeds)
- Tweak made to the crafting ingredients for the Mega Buster (+1 Tears of a Worm)
- Tweak made to the crafting ingredients for the Airstrike (+2 Boggy’s Special Sauce)
- Tweaks made to the Cluster Bomb and crafted variants (+2 Boggy's Special Sauce) [/b]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][b]
- Improvements to performance
- Fixed graphical corruption in imported landscapes
- Game stays at the correct resolution after minimising and maximising the game on Linux
- Fixed the issue where the input occurs on the game window when it doesn’t have focus
- Fixed an issue where the camera moved whilst crafting during an opponent’s turn
- Fixed an issue where the camera would look at the location of already exploded barrels
- Fixed an issue with the orientation of worm when blasted from vehicle
- Fixed an issue whereby the turn wasn’t handing over if surrendering worms took damage[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/3b1558a8767cbcaefb7793a30c50a8e495a52c58.gif[/img]
